title: Harissa tempeh salad
summary: Harissa tempeh salad is a middle eastern dinner built around tempeh and rose harissa paste, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Have everything for Harissa tempeh salad chopped before the pan goes on. Pat tempeh dry and season it.
steps.tip: A short cook only works if the chopping is finished first.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook tempeh until just done. Lift it out.
In the same pan, cook rose harissa paste and cucumber until hot and lightly browned. Return tempeh and toss with the lemon, lime or sauce.
Taste Harissa tempeh salad, add salt if it needs it, and serve straight away.
steps.tip: Taste Harissa tempeh salad before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.
